data.long_meaning: In Arabic, buhayyah means 'revival' or 'resurrection'. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'buhaha', which means 'to live' or 'to make live'. This name holds significant spiritual relevance in Islam as it is mentioned in the Quran in reference to the revival of the dead on the Day of Judgment. The name buhayyah carries the meaning “Revival, Resurrection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose buhayyah usually hope their child will grow to embody revival, resurrection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
